##### Project general facts

Amwaj Tower by Emirates Properties Real Estate & Development is a stunning residential project that perfectly combines modern comfort with coastal luxury. Located near the serene Ajman beachfront, it offers beautifully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments created to suit every family size and lifestyle. Each home features smart layouts, generous spaces, and beautiful natural lighting, making every apartment feel bright, elegant, and welcoming.

The tower offers an impressive range of premium amenities designed to elevate everyday living. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped gym, a spacious swimming pool, dedicated kids’ play areas, landscaped gardens, sauna and steam rooms, relaxation zones, and 24-hour security. With dedicated parking for every apartment and convenient on-site retail and restaurants, Amwaj Tower truly delivers a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and luxury.

The interiors of Amwaj Tower reflect quality, style, and attention to detail in every corner. The living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and guest areas are thoughtfully designed to create a refined yet cozy atmosphere, perfect for modern living. High-quality finishes, and elegant materials ensure that each apartment feels sophisticated, durable, and ready to provide long-term comfort and value.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman strategically positioned between other emirates, it shares a border with Sharjah and lies just 10 km from Dubai, offering convenient connectivity across the country. With its year-round sunshine, peaceful beaches, unspoiled natural landscapes, and ancient mangroves, Ajman provides a serene escape from the fast pace of modern life. Its blend of rich traditions, authentic culture, and modern infrastructure creates a truly distinctive living experience.

Ajman's growing appeal and commitment to sustainable development continue to attract investors eager to explore its promising business landscape. The establishment of the Ajman Free Zone and investor visa reforms have boosted confidence among foreign investors, injecting more liquidity into the local economy. 

UAE regulations offering pathways to citizenship and a more welcoming environment for expatriates further position Ajman as a thriving destination for living and business. Thanks to its steady development and cultural heritage, Ajman offers a calming yet luxurious atmosphere. This unique combination gives it an edge over other emirates, making it especially attractive for those seeking comfort, elegance, and peace in one place.
